title: Panda Adventure gravity configuration
description: Authoritative config for S3 Gravity Gun + Gravity Field + MP economy (gADR-0000: JSON is the single source of truth). The field's EFFECT is data (gADR-0002): a velocity vector (direction x strength) applied within a radius for a duration — lift is the shipped default, slam/redirect are other values of the same params, not code paths. Converted by scripts/build_config.py into the derived content/data/generated/gravity_config.tres (GravityConfig); the field_radius and obstacle_size dimensions migrated OUT to scale_spec.json (gADR-0013) and are composed back in by the builder.

mp_cost.description: MP spent per Gravity Gun fire — the game's only MP sink; strictly positive (a free fire would unbudget the change-gravity pillar). The Wine restore that refills this budget lives in items_config.json since S7 (gADR-0008).

field_direction.description: Direction of the field velocity as (x, y); normalized at runtime, so only the direction matters. Godot is +Y-down: lift = [0, -1] (the shipped fire default), slam = [0, 1], redirect = a horizontal or diagonal vector (gADR-0002).

field_strength.description: Magnitude of the field velocity in px/s; strictly positive.

field_duration.description: Seconds the field ACTS before expiring (the effect window; the fade-out after it is visual only); strictly positive.

field_color.description: Field block color as RGBA, each component in 0..1; the alpha carries the field's translucency.

field_asset.description: Optional view asset reference for the Gravity Field block (P2-S2, #436): a res:// path or asset-pipeline id the view seam resolves; absent (or empty) renders the colored-block fallback. Authored empty until an asset slice fills it (asset references are data, gADR-0000).

field_fade_duration.description: Seconds of the spawn fade-in and expiry fade-out tweens (the field's blockout animation); strictly positive.

field_spawn_offset.description: Field spawn offset (x, y) in pixels from the Player origin; x is scaled by facing (the Projectile's spawn pattern).

enemy_max_gravity_offset.description: Max total displacement (px) Gravity Fields can accumulate on the static Enemy — the clamp of its clamped-displacement integration (gADR-0002); strictly positive.

obstacle_color.description: Obstacle block color as RGBA, each component in 0..1.

obstacle_asset.description: Optional view asset reference for the Obstacle block: an Asset manifest id the builder resolves to the single-homed res:// path (P2-S1, #439, gADR-0014); absent (or empty) renders the colored-block fallback. Filled by the asset pipeline's tracer with the downloaded Obstacle texture id (asset references are data, gADR-0000).

obstacle_position.description: Obstacle center position (x, y) in pixels — the StaticBody2D origin. Placed clear of the Laser Gun's bolt line so the floating block never shields the Enemy.

obstacle_max_gravity_offset.description: Max total displacement (px) Gravity Fields can accumulate on the Obstacle — the clamp of its clamped-displacement integration (gADR-0002); strictly positive.
